verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a sandbox and agent-execution platform, but the evidence pack never documents a recurring schedule or cron capability. The closest items are one-off benchmark job submission, deploying agents through a GitHub Action, and idle auto-shutdown or suspend/resume. These are one-off actions, a host-platform workflow, or adjacent lifecycle controls, not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
